state.project_contract: The existing epoch1 cold callback checks bound nonce/identity/sequence, parked workers and no deferred IRQ/release/arm/drain. Any committed claim/write and software lease must remain retained after ambiguous late failure. No physical exclusion/coherency/drain is proven, and there is no retirement/reset API.
state.proposed_indication_owner: A one-shot private owner captures the existing allocator type1 WLAN-arena reservation and its type6 indication span. Preflight requires fresh zero records and exact geometry. Hooks reserve/record each original status-word write and deny false outer success after a partial or late failure, without clearing committed words or other packet/BA owners.

owner_kind.instructions: In indication_body, which resource is being initialized? Classify the shown writes, not the function name.

criteria.indication_records: 8-byte indication records have their status word ORed with0xe0000000; no buffer-ID pool is dequeued.
criteria.ba_pages: BA page IDs are dequeued and allocated.
criteria.packet_pool: Packet IDs are dequeued and allocated.
criteria.unknown: The supplied body does not establish a resource class.

geometry_not_ownership.instructions: Does a count bound alone establish the immutable indication span and its retained cold owner, according to project_contract and proposed_indication_owner?

failure_policy.instructions: Under project_contract, what should proposed_indication_owner do after an ambiguous failure following a committed indication write?

criteria.retain_no_reset: Latch fault and retain committed words/reservation/lease; deny outer success without a reset or rollback API.
criteria.clear_restart: Clear the initialized prefix and restart.
criteria.free: Retire the arena when the CPU callback returns.
criteria.unknown: The contract does not establish a policy.

tx_side_effects.instructions: Does tx_initializer only store host-address metadata or also program native hardware base registers?

criteria.base_register_writes: The shown body writes native1fc... base registers as part of TX initialization.
criteria.metadata_only: It only stores SRAM address metadata.
criteria.unknown: The shown body does not establish side effects.

separate_physical_claim.instructions: Would proposed_indication_owner by itself prove physical prior-user exclusion, DMA/cache coherency or retirement, when project_contract explicitly lacks those witnesses?
